evals.prompt: Package all applicant data in data/preparer/ into submission.json files.
evals.expected_output: submission.json is created for each applicant with all sections populated.
assertions: submission.json exists and is valid JSON

evals.prompt: Package applicant data when oral transcript is missing.

stderr contains warning about missing oral transcript
q1_written and q3_logical are fully populated
